_comment: Candidate background for the LLM fit scorer. The whole object is sent to the model for each new posting. Updated with Lisa's own prioritized target titles (§4), her 'search by problem, not title' signal vocabulary (§5), and her positioning / unifying-thread language (§6). Editing this file changes the bg fingerprint, so all of Lisa's cached verdicts re-score on the next run. Fields marked TODO were intentionally omitted from her source docs — confirm for best scoring.
name: Lisa Hillier
current_title: Senior Director Customer Experience | Strategic Practice Leader | Experience Design
seniority_target: Manager (with team / function / workstream leadership scope)
seniority_flexibility: Lisa is GENUINELY OPEN to Manager and Senior Manager roles, not only Director+/C-level. Do NOT down-rank or reject a role solely because its title is below Director. Judge seniority by scope and mandate, not by the title word: a Manager or Senior Manager role with real leadership scope and a transformation / operations / strategy / M&A / org-effectiveness / customer / professional-services mandate is a STRONG fit and should score high. Only apply a seniority penalty when the role is individual-contributor or non-leadership.
common_thread: Lisa helps organizations build the operating and leadership capabilities required to navigate growth and major transformation WITHOUT losing the people, knowledge, customer value, and operational strengths that made them successful. She is strongest entering complex or fast-growing environments, creating structure, improving performance, and helping teams scale.
positioning: Targets Director / Senior Director / Head-of roles in enterprise transformation, strategy & operations, M&A integration, organizational effectiveness, and enterprise AI adoption — turning complex change into stronger operating capability and measurable business performance.
priority_target_titles: Chief of Staff, Strategy and Operations
title_caveat: Lisa's best-fit roles are FREQUENTLY POORLY OR GENERICALLY TITLED (as several of her own past roles were). Judge fit primarily from the mandate, scope, and problems in the description — not from title keywords. A generically-titled senior role whose description matches the problem_signals below can be an excellent fit.

problem_signals._note: Description language that indicates a strong fit even when the title does not. These mirror Lisa's own boolean search strings.

Improved revenue, margin, utilization, customer metrics, engagement, and retention

a transformation / strategy-&-operations / M&A-integration / org-effectiveness / customer-or-professional-services leadership mandate (judged by mandate, not necessarily by title)
nice_to_haves: enterprise AI adoption / enablement / transformation mandate

M&A integration and enterprise AI adoption
